body.heading: Where in the world is Fiji?
paragraphs: Fiji is a country in Melanesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Fiji is Suva.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Fiji speak English, Fijian and Hindi.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Fiji is the Fijian dollar.

body.heading: How big is Fiji?
paragraphs: Fiji covers about 18,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Mamanucas are Fiji's postcard islands — families island-hop to snorkel reefs, ride the famous surf breaks' gentler cousins and relax in bure huts.
Near Nadi, this garden overflows with orchids beneath the Sleeping Giant mountain — then it's time to get gloriously muddy in the hot springs.
